author.name: Hemayet Hossain
author.description: Hemayet Hossain is based in Sydney and is the founder of Hossain Consulting. He writes about Salesforce, AI and workflow automation, sharing lessons from self-directed projects and software prototypes. His articles distinguish tested results from ideas still being explored.

author.name: Hemayet Hossain
author.description: Hemayet Hossain is the Sydney-based founder of Hossain Consulting, a developing CRM and automation practice for trade and home-service businesses.
